coverage: Guyana administrative reference from the retained licensed source. All hierarchy levels dissolve from the same jointly simplified local partition (0.00008 degree display tolerance, approximately five to nine metres). Source water-only polygons are excluded from administrative units. Shared international arcs use one owner and common junctions; existing neighboring administrative geometry remains fixed. Population observations retain their own year and coverage. Only ten administrative regions are used; the older 27 local reference areas do not establish a current local-government roster. Guyana-administered territory is not reassigned to Venezuela because of a claim. National World Bank GDP and GDP per capita are retained without distributing national output among subdivisions. Country overview pages remain hidden.
